purpose: Review a finite set of offline Campaign104 concepts against the complete v61 mechanism history before reading any Campaign104 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_path_efficiency_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: On direct active adjacent amount/volume transaction-price pairs within each half-session, return abs(sum(log(p_j/p_j-1)))/sum(abs(log(p_j/p_j-1))), with p=amount/volume and no bridge across an inactive bar.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign007 explicitly froze transaction-price path efficiency, reversal, sign, lead, and lag transforms as prohibited Campaign006 repair rather than a new economic mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_one_tick_close_update_share_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Among nonzero adjacent raw-close updates wholly inside the two continuous half-sessions, return the share whose absolute arithmetic change is exactly one CNY 0.01 tick.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The statistic conditions Campaign034's already-exposed raw CNY tick-grid mechanism on the terminal adjacent price-update mechanism. It is an old-factor field/operator combination, not an independent raw mechanism, and would add nominal-price and board exposure after both families were observed.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_directional_profile_persistence_131f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: For exact current/prior accepted-session rows, compute a same-stock Pearson correlation between the paired current and prior frozen-direction component-rank vectors over all 131 numeric definitions.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It reuses Campaign103's exact temporal complete-library source, prior-session relation, and paired-support problem while replacing only the vote aggregator. v61 forbids Campaign103 support, vote, reweight, model, or combination rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_prior_close_excursion_imbalance_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: For each destination bar inside a half-session, measure positive log high excursion above the prior close and positive log prior-close excursion above the low, then return their signed mass imbalance.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This combines the terminal two-sided running-range frontier family with the prior-close/destination-range gap-containment family and changes their anchor and magnitude allocation after exposure. It does not establish a new information domain.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_odd_lot_aggregate_volume_residue_share_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Return the share of active standard minute bars whose aggregate share volume is not divisible by a presumed round-lot size.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted source provides bar-aggregate share volume, not order- or trade-size records. A residue of an aggregate cannot identify odd-lot participation, and the frozen source contract contains no point-in-time board-specific order-lot rule. The proposed economic interpretation is therefore unsupported by the available schema.
